AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.heroSubtitle: Niš in Europe, Europe in Niš
AboutUs.heroDescription: Your trusted partner for buying, selling, and renting properties
AboutUs.whoWeAreText1: OLYMP REAL ESTATE was formed by a group of experienced, professional people in the real estate field. The idea was to offer the Niš and Serbian market a newer, higher quality, more comprehensive, and more modern approach to real estate brokerage.
AboutUs.whoWeAreText2: We have managed to create something new in our market, we have managed to make progress in accepting our place and our role in real estate transactions. In parallel with real estate brokerage, the company can meet clients with projects for adaptations, extensions, additions, and we have formed a professional team of highly qualified people in the field of construction and craft work, thus completing our offer.
AboutUs.ourMissionText: This means that OLYMP REAL ESTATE is able to offer its business partners various properties (apartments, houses, premises...), professional consulting services in the form of all kinds of professional assistance, as well as work on the properties themselves.
AboutUs.ourVisionText: The next step in our work is construction or investment in residential buildings, i.e., building apartments for the market according to European standards, with the Serbian tradition and value that our people have shown throughout the world. In all these business ventures, the basic idea and direction of action is the complete legal security of our clients.

AboutUs.value2Description: Complete openness and clarity in all business transactions

AboutUs.value4Description: Modern approach and European standards in business
